notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Dropped the shared preset's prepull Demonic Sacrifice (18788): the talent tree names that id as the tier 2 Demonology talent's own spell, but the build's spellconst has no entry for 18788 at all, so this build cannot cast it under that id -- a concern for the engine lane to resolve (either a different cast id for the sacrifice effect or the talent is not yet implemented client-side). Corruption and Life Tap were kept from the shared preset. Fixed the same stale Shadow Bolt rank the preset carried (25307 cast at rank 9 where the build's current top rank is 10). Immolate and the Bane of Agony curse maintenance from the shared preset were dropped -- Demonology's own capstone is Decimation (440870), which drops Soul Fire's 60 second cooldown to near nothing after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain crit, so Soul Fire is cast unconditionally on cooldown ahead of the Shadow Bolt filler rather than gated on a proc aura: Decimation's effect could not be confirmed in spellconst as a separate trackable buff, so relying on the spell's own cooldown state (skip when it is down, fall through otherwise) is the safer default. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Corruption is cheap sustained damage that does not compete with Shadow Bolt casts.
Soul Fire on cooldown: Decimation drops its 60 second cooldown to near nothing after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain crit, so this is skipped whenever it is still down and taken whenever it is up.
Shadow Bolt is the default filler and what feeds Decimation's proc.
